name: taxformatter
description: Parse crypto exchange CSVs and bank statement PDFs into structured transaction data, ready for Koinly / TurboTax / CoinLedger / ZenLedger. Calls the hosted TaxFormatter API.
author: TaxFormatter

env.name: TAXFORMATTER_API_KEY
env.description: TaxFormatter API key (tf_live_...). Get one at https://taxformatter.com/dashboard/developer — free tier is 10 files/month, no credit card required.

env.name: TAXFORMATTER_API_URL
env.description: API base URL override. Defaults to https://api.taxformatter.com.

tools.name: parse_crypto_csv
tools.description: Parse a crypto exchange CSV (Coinbase, Binance, Kraken, etc.) and convert to a tax software format. Auto-detects the exchange if not specified.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the CSV file

tools.name: parse_bank_statement
tools.description: Parse a bank statement PDF (Chase, Mercury, Navy Federal, etc.) and extract transactions as structured data. Auto-detects the bank.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the PDF file

tools.name: list_supported_sources
tools.description: List all supported crypto exchanges and banks. No arguments.
